adjudication.rationale: The new scheduled job `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` calls `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (line ~35). `String#scrub` is not defined in older Rubies (pre-2.1) and the diff only adds `ruby-readability` and `simple-rss`—no backport like `string-scrub`/`scrub_rb` appears in the lockfile additions. If the project runs on Ruby <2.1, this will raise `NoMethodError` during feed polling and prevent imports.
